title: 盐湖倒影
en: A lone cyclist crosses a narrow causeway through a vast salt lake at dawn, the lavender sky perfectly reflected in shallow water, distant mountains dissolve into mist, low wide camera, delicate pastel light and enormous negative space.

title: 山间列车
en: A red mountain railway winds through emerald terraced hills after a summer shower, seen from a distant hillside through foreground wildflowers, clouds opening to reveal shafts of sunlight, believable rail geometry and layered atmospheric depth.

title: 雨中书店
en: A young adult woman in a cream sweater browses a tiny secondhand bookshop during an afternoon downpour, warm tungsten lamps contrast with cool wet windows, side profile, natural hands holding an open book, intimate 50mm composition.

title: 海边重逢
en: Two young adult lovers meet on a quiet seaside promenade at blue hour, standing a few steps apart with restrained smiles, wind moving their coats, distant fishing boats and soft harbor lights, eye-level medium wide shot.

title: 森林玻璃屋
en: A modern glass cabin sits among towering moss-covered redwoods, morning fog threading between trunks, warm interior light and subtle reflections on glazing, architectural wide shot, precise material detail.

title: 沙丘旅人
en: A solitary traveler in a rust-colored cloak stands on a sweeping desert dune ridge, wind lifting fine sand across the foreground, monumental layered dunes under a pale sun, restrained ochre palette and realistic shadows.

title: 冰川之下
en: Two small mountaineers stand inside a vast translucent blue glacial cavern, daylight filtering through textured ice overhead, natural crevasses and reflections, wide environmental framing with believable scale.

title: 夜色厨房
en: An elderly chef prepares noodles in a modest late-night restaurant, steam rises under warm pendant lights, rain-speckled windows reveal a quiet street, candid documentary composition, authentic utensils and natural hand anatomy.

title: 海上风暴
en: A small weathered fishing vessel navigates a dark rolling sea beneath a dramatic storm front, distant sunlight breaks through a narrow gap in clouds, realistic water physics and spray, long-lens maritime cinema.

title: 未来温室
en: A botanist walks through a vast orbital greenhouse, rows of leafy crops beneath curved transparent panels revealing Earth in the distance, practical lighting, plausible engineering, balanced symmetrical framing.

title: 秋日校园
en: A young adult student pauses beside a bicycle under golden ginkgo trees on a university avenue, scattered leaves and soft afternoon backlight, candid expression, gentle nostalgic color grading, medium wide composition.

title: 最后一束光
en: A deserted coastal cinema with faded velvet seats and a single beam of sunset entering through a side window, floating dust and worn wooden floor, quiet symmetrical composition, tactile detail and melancholy atmosphere.
